title: Executive KPI overview
text: Overall revenue is £20,077,305.60 across 39,575 orders and 5,862 registered customers. Average order value is £507.32. Period runs 2009-12-01 to 2011-12-09. UK revenue share is 85.6% (£17,189,769.60). Return rate is 3.64% by value. Guest checkout lines are 22.9% of sales lines. Calendar 2010→2011 revenue change is -3.28%, orders -7.37%, customers -0.05%.
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(LineAmount),2) AS Revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT Invoice) AS Orders FROM v_fact_sales;

title: Monthly seasonality
text: Monthly revenue peaks in 2011-11 at £1,453,266 (2751 orders). Softest month in the series is 2011-02 at £508,082. November gift-season peaks appear in both 2010 and 2011.
sql: SELECT YearMonth, Revenue, Orders FROM v_mart_monthly ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

title: United Kingdom revenue
text: United Kingdom contributes £17,189,769.60 (85.6% of total revenue). Across calendar 2010 vs 2011, total revenue moved -3.28% (£9,799,869 → £9,478,704) while AOV rose from £498.04 to £520.04. A UK 'drop' question should be checked against the monthly mart, not only the full-period total — seasonality and Dec partial months matter.
sql: SELECT Country, ROUND(SUM(LineAmount),2) AS Revenue FROM v_fact_sales WHERE Country='United Kingdom';

title: Top countries by revenue
text: Top markets by revenue — United Kingdom: £17,189,770 revenue, 36,212 orders; EIRE: £640,175 revenue, 598 orders; Netherlands: £549,951 revenue, 216 orders; Germany: £388,401 revenue, 756 orders; France: £317,203 revenue, 602 orders; Australia: £168,417 revenue, 89 orders; Spain: £98,789 revenue, 147 orders; Switzerland: £94,248 revenue, 85 orders; Sweden: £86,319 revenue, 99 orders; Denmark: £68,560 revenue, 42 orders.
sql: SELECT Country, SUM(LineAmount) AS Revenue FROM v_fact_sales GROUP BY Country ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

title: Top products by revenue
text: Highest revenue SKUs: REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER (£344,069); WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER (£262,768); JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT (£183,136); PAPER CRAFT , LITTLE BIRDIE (£168,470); PARTY BUNTING (£149,109); ASSORTED COLOUR BIRD ORNAMENT (£131,818); PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS (£123,003); CHILLI LIGHTS (£85,158); MEDIUM CERAMIC TOP STORAGE JAR (£81,701); SMALL POPCORN HOLDER (£80,888). Top-5 SKUs are 5.5% of revenue.
sql: SELECT StockCode, SUM(LineAmount) AS Revenue FROM v_fact_sales GROUP BY StockCode ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

title: RFM customer segments
text: Registered customers split into 4 RFM segments. Champions: 979 customers, £12,505,251 revenue; Loyal Customers: 1867 customers, £3,454,527 revenue; Promising: 1381 customers, £576,974 revenue; At Risk / Lapsed: 1635 customers, £857,425 revenue. Overall repeat rate is 72.3% and end-window Churned90 rate is 50.7%.

title: Returns and cancellations
text: Return value is £731,662.80, a 3.64% rate versus sales value. Returns include C-prefix cancels and negative quantity lines; fee codes are excluded.
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ReturnAmount)/(SELECT SUM(LineAmount) FROM v_fact_sales),4) AS return_rate FROM v_fact_returns;
